GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
Nelson Mandela Marg, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070

NOTIFICATION: NATIONAL TECHNICAL TALENT SCHOLARSHIP 2026-27
Notification No: AICTE/NMS/2026-27/001
Date of Issue: 15 October 2026

1. OBJECTIVE & SCHEME OVERVIEW:
Applications are invited from meritorious and economically weaker students pursuing regular undergraduate engineering programs for the award of the "National Technical Talent Scholarship 2026".

2. SCHOLARSHIP VALUE & FEES:
- Scholarship Amount: INR 50,000 per annum credited directly to beneficiary bank account via DBT.
- Application Processing Fee: NIL (Completely Free).

3. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
a) The applicant must be a regular full-time student enrolled in 2nd year of B.E./B.Tech program in an AICTE approved institution.
b) Minimum academic qualification: 75% aggregate marks or 7.5 CGPA out of 10 in the first year of engineering.
c) Annual family gross income from all sources must not exceed INR 4,50,000 (Four Lakhs Fifty Thousand Only) for the financial year 2025-26.
d) The applicant must not be in receipt of any other central or state government scholarship exceeding INR 20,000 per annum.

4. MANDATORY DATES & CLOSING DEADLINE:
- Online Registration Opens: 16 October 2026, 10:00 AM IST
- Application Submission Deadline: 30 October 2026 up to 17:00 IST
- Verification of Documents by College: 05 November 2026

5. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
1. Valid Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar/SDM) on or after 01 April 2026.
2. Attested copies of First Year B.Tech marksheets (1st and 2nd semesters).
3. College Bonafide Certificate signed by Principal/Head of Institution.
4. Aadhaar Card linked with active bank account.
5. Recent passport size photograph.

6. APPLICATION PROCEDURE:
Step 1: Register on the National Scholarship Portal at https://scholarships.gov.in.
Step 2: Complete student demographic and academic profile.
Step 3: Upload scanned original certificates in PDF format (max 500KB per file).
Step 4: Submit online application on or before 30 October 2026, 17:00 IST.
Step 5: Submit printed hardcopy acknowledgement along with physical photocopies to College Student Welfare Section.

7. CONTACT & HELPDESK:
Member Secretary, National Scholarship Cell, AICTE HQs.
Email: support-scholarship@aicte-india.org | Telephone: 011-29581000
